chapter: Playing in the Snow Counts as Training Too!
act_title: Playing in the Snow Counts as Training Too!

quests.title: Playing in the Snow Counts as Training Too!

dialogue.t: Mr. Honorary Knight(Miss Honorary Knight)! Over here, over here!
Klee just made some new friends! Wanna come play with us?
They taught us a new game called Snowtrace.
The rules aren't hard. It's just a very special kind of hide-and-seek!
Aww! Klee, Yaoyao, and Sayu, so you've all become friends!
From the name alone, this game sounds like an upgraded version of Windtrace, huh? Hehe, Paimon can't wait to play with you!

dialogue.sit: I'd love to meet Klee's new friends too!

dialogue.t: Achoo... Even though it isn't that cold at the camp, I'm still feeling a little sleepy...
Hmm? Are my eyes playing tricks on me, or do I see {NICKNAME} and Paimon?
Your eyes are working perfectly fine. That's {NICKNAME} and Paimon alright.

dialogue.sit: Hey there, Yaoyao! Hey there, Sayu!

dialogue.t: Good idea! Once we get moving and start having fun, we won't doze off that easily!
And didn't that awfully serious Miss Sumire say that spending more time in the snowy mountains would be good for your skills, Sayu?
Ugh, I can't believe you guys remembered that!
Alright... But if I lose to my peers or even to that super Ninken, slacking off is going to get a lot more difficult in the future.
Looks like I'm really going to have to pull up my socks on this trip.
And don't you worry! I came up with a new Goulash recipe using Jueyun Chili and ground pepper, and I just made some.
Take a few bites of it before you start. I promise you won't feel cold at all during the game.
That sounds great! Hang on, I'll have a whole bowl first!
Paimon wants some too!
Alright then, let's get our game of hide-and-seek started here in the snowy mountain!
Hehe! The whole mountain's covered in snow — it's the perfect hiding spot for Paimon!

quests.description: Looks like Klee has had quite the unusual encounter during the Cross Country Challenge. Let’s go check on her now!
